# run_cygwin_from_jupyter_rt { #mofography.helper.run_cygwin_from_jupyter_rt }

```python
helper.run_cygwin_from_jupyter_rt(
    cygwin_command,
    cygwin_path='C:\\cygwin64\\bin',
)
```

Run a Cygwin command from a Jupyter notebook in real-time.

Args:
    cygwin_command: The command to run in Cygwin.
    cygwin_path: The path to the Cygwin installation (default is r"C:\cygwin64in").

Returns:
    int: The return code of the process.
